title: Help check our translations
intro: We translated the IQRA quizzes into Bangla and Tamil with care. Scholars and readers who know these languages help us make sure every word is right.
step1: Download a sheet for your language: one subject, or all of them in one file.
step2: Open it in Excel or Google Sheets. Read the English and the translation side by side.
step3: Where the translation is wrong or missing, type the right text in the <yellow>yellow correction column</yellow>. Put any comment in reviewer_note. Do not change the other columns.
step4: Send the file back to the IQRA team by email or WhatsApp. You will find how to reach us on the <about>About page</about>.
downloadAllHint: One Excel file, one tab for each of the {{n}} subjects.
awaitingLede: Players do not see these subjects in this language until a scholar has checked them.
othersLede: Already shown to players. Corrections are still welcome.
